Three form-only eliminations leave B as the sole coherent option'). L16 (q:2) and L17 (q:3) are flag/WORLD_KNOWLEDGE and flag/PARTIALLY. gates/README.md gate inventory row 5: 'G-STEM | prompt | per question | structural leak (form-answerable options/stem) or pure factual recall -> kill'; the flow diagram routes any stage-2 kill to 'DEAD (stop)'. gates/prompts/G-STEM.md line 87: 'STRUCTURAL_LEAK or RECALL_ONLY -> kill (severity lethal)'. The one escape hatch in that prompt - 'a blind pick that is *wrong* demotes the finding to flag' - does NOT apply: blind_pick D on q1 equals key D, blind_pick B on q4 equals key B, both correct. Meanwhile generator_meta.originality_note states only 'RE-GATE REQUIRED: because questions[3].options[D].text changed, this unit needs a G-KEY / G-DISTRACTOR re-gate', and reviews/pedagogy.jsonl's 2026-07-30 round-2 line likewise says 'only q3's distractor D text changed so a G-KEY/G-DISTRACTOR re-gate is flagged' - neither mentions G-STEM, and no adjudication, override or amended-gate certification for these two kills exists anywhere in batch1 (grepped ADJUDICATION.md, ADJUDICATION-MASTER.md, CORRECTIONS.md, PEDAGOGY-ADJUDICATION.md, LANGUAGE-ADJUDICATION.md, reviews/*.jsonl).
findings.why: The audit brief made regate-lastness a required probe. The r2 lines are last, and their content is lethal under the campaign's own published kill rule, with the prompt's own demotion clause inapplicable because both blind picks match the keys. A unit whose most recent lethal-correctness gate kills half its questions cannot be certified, and the repair's own record does not even disclose that the gate ran. This is the same class of failure the round-1 campaign was refuted for: a record that reads as cleared while the underlying evidence says otherwise.

findings.stage_challenged: real-entity repair (biology of the replacement species)
findings.claim: The passage's causal connective in 'en liten vitblommig angsvaxt med skilda han- och honplantor, som darfor ar helt beroende av insekter for sin forokning' overreaches slightly: dioecy entails obligate outcrossing, not obligate entomophily (a dioecious plant can be wind-pollinated).
findings.evidence: Passage paragraph 4, method sentence. The inference dioecy => 'helt beroende av INSEKTER' skips the vector step. The surrounding description supplies the missing premise implicitly - white flowers, opening at dusk, strongest scent in darkness (paragraph 3) is the textbook moth-pollination syndrome, modelled on the real dioecious Silene latifolia (sv. vitblara; GBIF /v1/species/search?q=vitblara -> count 12, top hit 'Silene latifolia Poir.'; sv.wikipedia article 'Vitblara' exists).
findings.why: Not refutation-grade - the species is invented, so no real organism is misdescribed, and the syndrome makes the conclusion defensible. Recorded because the round-1 refutation was precisely about biology stated too strongly, and the replacement inherits a weaker version of the same habit. A short hedge ('och som pollineras av nattfjarilar') would close it.

findings.claim: 'skymningsglim' is bearer-free (independently confirmed) but sits one morpheme from the real Swedish species 'nattglim' (Silene noctiflora), whose biology is the opposite of the fictional plant's, and uses the 'glim' morpheme where Swedish nomenclature puts dioecious Silene under 'blara'. The note's own rejection standard was applied more strictly to 'skymningsklocka' than to the name it kept.
findings.evidence: GBIF species search: 'skymningsglim' count 0; 'nattglim' count 6, top hit 'Silene noctiflora L.'; 'vitblara' count 12, top hit 'Silene latifolia Poir.'. sv.wikipedia: 'nattglim' -> article Nattglim exists; 'vitblara' -> article Vitblara exists; 'skymningsglim' plain and insource -> totalhits 0. Silene noctiflora is hermaphrodite and strongly selfing, i.e. contradicts the fictional plant's obligate outcrossing; Silene latifolia (vitblara) is the dioecious, white, dusk-opening, night-scented one - and is a 'blara', not a 'glim'. The note rejected 'skymningsklocka' solely because sv.wikipedia plain search surfaced the unrelated real song title 'Skymningsklockor' (reproduced: sv.wikipedia 'skymningsklocka' -> totalhits 3, top hit 'Evening Chimes'), a far weaker near-form than a real congener in the same genus and the same habitat.
findings.why: No collision and no student-facing falsehood - a coined Swedish plant name necessarily resembles real ones, and every bearer probe is clean. Documented as an inconsistency in the repair's stated selection standard, not charged.

findings.stage_challenged: real-entity repair - independent broad-web sweep the note marked NOT RUN
findings.claim: I ran the broad-web sweep the note honestly declined to claim, and it found no real bearer for any name in the passage in any related domain.
findings.evidence: WebSearch budget was exhausted for this session and both DuckDuckGo (empty result set) and Mojeek (HTTP 403 after two queries) blocked scripted exact-phrase queries, so the sweep ran through Exa. 'Selmerlund' (efternamn person Sverige) -> only near-forms: Hans Selmer Ostlund, Selma Selander, Selma Zetterlund, Selma Lundstrom, Selma Lundin - no bearer of the surname Selmerlund. 'Klovsater' (plats Sverige) -> only near-forms: Klovsatra (Gavleborg), Klovern Sater, Klovsjo, Klovberget, Klaverod - no bearer. 'Korseberg' as an entomologist -> returns real Swedish entomologists (Anders Lindstrom, Kjell Arne Johanson, Johannes Bergsten, Maartje Klapwijk) but no Korseberg. sv.wikipedia insource:/Korseberg/ -> 19 hits, all place articles (Vastergotland, Vanersborg, Nya Varvet, Hono); insource:/Bjallerup/ -> 42 hits, all Staffanstorp-area toponymy (Staffanstorps kommun, Torna harad). Consistent with my round-1 finding that both surnames are place-derived with no personal bearer of note.
findings.why: Satisfies the audit brief's second duty independently of the repair agent's own logs and of my own round-1 pass. No named entity in the current passage has a real bearer in the night-pollination / ecology / Swedish-place domain.

findings.claim: Both round-1 refutation majors are genuinely closed.
findings.evidence: (1) False biology about a real red-listed species: 'faltgentiana', 'Faltgentianan' and 'gentian*' now appear ZERO times in the title, passage, all four stems, all sixteen options, all four rationales and every generator_meta key except originality_note (where they survive only as the repair's own audit trail; generator_meta is never rendered to students). The passage's method sentence now measures frosattning on the invented 'skymningsglim', and q3 option D - the option that reprinted the false property to students - now reads 'Skymningsglim ar helt beroende av insekter for att kunna foroka sig', true within the fiction; q3's rationale was updated in step ('D is true_but_irrelevant: skymningsglim's insect-dependence...'), as was q2's ('...the background paragraph does say that skymningsglim opens at dusk and smells strongest in the dark...'). Every remaining real-organism statement in the passage checks out biologically: sea-turtle hatchlings orienting to artificial lights instead of the sea; night-migrating birds disoriented around lit structures; bees and bumblebees as the day-time crop pollinators; and honungsbin explicitly described as day-active and therefore unaffected after dusk. The moth horizon-glow navigation claim is framed as the fictional researcher's explanation ('Selmerlunds forklaring bygger pa...'), not as settled fact, and 'himlaranden' is now explicitly attributed to the fictional group rather than presented as established Swedish usage. (2) The false 'stems byte-identical' provenance claim: the new note opens by naming it as round 1's error and states the corrected fact, which my own HEAD diff confirms - q1/q3/q4 stems identical to HEAD, only q2's stem differs ('Vad anger Vikbrandt...' -> 'Vad anger Selmerlund...'), which is round 1's rename.
findings.why: The specific defects this unit was refuted for are gone, in the content and not merely in the name. The refutation above rests on a different, newly surfaced failure.

(2) Keys and letters, diffed against 'git show HEAD:<path>': keys D/A/C/B in both; option letters A-D in order in all four questions in both; fifteen of sixteen option texts byte-identical to HEAD, the sixteenth being q3 D (the species swap); title, section, family, candidate_id, families_by_qindex, distractor_traps_by_qindex, origin, model, date, macro_genre, fine_genre, opening_move and topic all byte-identical to HEAD; the only generator_meta key added since HEAD is originality_note; fictional_entities updated as described (Vikbrandt->Selmerlund, Ramsholmen->Klovsater from round 1, plus one entry 'skymningsglim (pahittad angsvaxt)' added by round 2); q1 and q4 rationales byte-identical to HEAD, q2 and q3 rationales differing only in the species noun and its property wording. (3) Rationale quotes against current text: every Swedish quoted fragment resolves - 'det ar slackningen som tycks ha lockat tillbaka insekterna, inte tvartom', 'omkring en tredjedel', 'inte ljuset i sig som skrammer dem', 'Endast vid de angar som lag narmare an hundra meter' and 'Att slacka eller rikta om enstaka lyktor kostar foga' in the passage; 'mangdubblade', 'samtliga angar', 'overallt', 'hela landskapet', 'avvecklas' and 'saknade helt nattaktiva fjarilar' in the current option texts. The only non-resolving strings are English glosses ('bright light hurts the eyes', 'more darkness, more benefit'), which are the reviewer's own paraphrases, not quotations. (4) stems/las-b1-001.json is fully in sync: all four stems and all sixteen option letters+texts match candidates-final exactly, and the stems file carries no key field. (5) Regate lastness: verdicts-vfinal contains exactly four files, each 18 lines, and this unit's entityfix-r2 lines are lines 15-18 - the last records in every one. G-KEY solver answers on both votes are D/A/C/B, matching the keys; G-DISTRACTOR is pass on all four questions on both rounds.
findings.why: Rename mechanics, answer design, cross-file sync and quote integrity are clean. The unit's failure is the G-STEM re-gate outcome, not consistency.
